descriptionByLocale.en:
Bachem AG continues to expand and invests in new buildings and production facilities for the production of innovative products. The goal of our vocational training is the sustainable and long-term development of specialist and leadership skills in the company in order to master future growth. Every year we offer an apprenticeship to the logistics specialist, specialization warehouse (a).

The 3-year training in Bachem is based on the model of trial training, in which theory, basic training and practice are taught at three learning locations.

• Most of the teaching is spent in the two main camps for technical and chemical materials. In addition, you visit the areas of tank storage, disposal, delivery and shipping. In order to get to know and understand the whole process of logistics, there are still 3 smaller stages in the areas of planning, purchasing and distribution.

• During one day a week you visit the business school in Liestal. In vocational studies, all theoretical foundations are laid, which are used in the work processes in practice.

• In addition to this practical and theoretical training, the trainees complete the intercompany courses of the SVBL (Swiss Association for Vocational Training in Logistics) and obtain, among other things, the truck driving licence.

Professional description:

The warehouse is the control center of our company. Here, logistics experts coordinate all material flows from a wide range of departments in the company. Delivered goods are unloaded, checked and recorded in the system by computer. Logistics operators pick goods based on customer orders and ensure the transport of goods to their destination. Goods are packed professionally, and with the help of modern forklifts and industrial trucks, loaded and secured according to regulations. They carry out the control of the stockpiles and optimally implement the requirements for a smooth flow of goods. Another area of responsibility is the professional disposal of residual materials and waste, in compliance with all environmental and legal regulations.

The logistics team ensures the flow of goods using modern tools. Just as they coordinate the material flows, they are also the contact points for the other departments involved in the goods flows.

• Good performance in the core subjects German and Mathematics

Um den ganzen Prozess der Logistik kenne zu lernen und zu verstehen, gibt es noch 3 kleinere Stagen in den Bereichen Planung, Einkauf und Distribution.

Das Lager ist die Schaltzentrale unserer Firma. Hier koordinieren Logistiker alle Materialflüsse der unterschiedlichsten Abteilungen im Unternehmen. Angelieferte Waren werden abgeladen, kontrolliert und mittels EDV im System verbucht. Logistiker kommissionieren Waren aufgrund von Kundenbestellungen und stellen den Transport der Güter an ihren Bestimmungsort sicher. Sie führen die Kontrolle der Lagerbestände durch und setzten die Anforderungen an einen reibungslosen Güterfluss optimal um. Ein weiteres Aufgabengebiet ist die fachgerechte Entsorgung von Reststoffen und Abfällen, unter Einhaltung aller umweltrechtlichen und gesetzlichen Vorschriften.

Die Logistiker stellen im Team den Warenfluss unter Verwendung moderner Hilfsmittel sicher. Genauso wie sie die Materialflüsse koordinieren sind sie auch die Ansprechpartner für die anderen an den Warenflüssen beteiligten Abteilungen.

Die dreijährige Ausbildung basiert auf dem Modell der trialen Ausbildung an verschiedenen Ausbildungsorten: • In der Berufsschule (Schulen kvBL Liestal) • Im ÜK-Zentrum Basel (IGKG beider Basel) • Bei den Praxisbildnern der Linie der Bachem AG an verschiedenen Arbeitsplätzen Berufsbeschreibung: Als Kauffrau/Kaufmann EFZ lernst du bei uns verschiedene Abteilungen kennen, die zum Teil auch international tätig sind. Somit eignest du dir ein vielseitiges kaufmännisches Wissen an und lernst das Gelernte aus der Theorie direkt in der Praxis anzuwenden. Dabei führst du Korrespondenz mit Kunden und Geschäftspartnern, schreibst Berichte, erstellst Protokolle und Tabellen. Im Weiteren befasst du dich mit dem Zahlungsverkehr, erstellst Rechnungen und hilfst auch in der Buchhaltung oder im Human Resources mit. Anforderungen: • Niveau E oder P der Sekundarschule Baselland (oder Gleichwertiges) • Gute Leistungen in den Kernfächer Deutsch, Mathematik und Englisch • Teamfähigkeit und offen Neues zu Lernen • Freude und Interesse an Zahlen und Sprachen • Flair und Interesse für die tägliche Arbeit am PC Bachem Benefits für Lernende: • Dein Monatslohn: 1. Lehrjahr: CHF 800.- / 2. Lehrjahr: CHF 1’000.- / 3. Lehrjahr: CHF 1’300.- (jeweils x 12) • 30 Ferientage für alle Lernende • Einmaliger Beitrag an den persönlichen Laptop • Monatlicher Beitrag an das U-Abo • Und viele weitere Benefits

jobs.description:
Afin de renforcer notre équipe Maintenance & Engineering sur notre site de Vionnaz, nous recherchons un(e) Automaticien de maintenance & Instrumentation (a) passionné(e) par la technique, le dépannage et l'amélioration continue.

Votre impact

En tant qu'expert(e) des systèmes d'automation, d'instrumentation et des installations électriques, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la disponibilité, la sécurité et la performance de nos équipements de production. Vous intervenez directement sur des installations stratégiques dans un environnement exigeant et fortement réglementé.

Vos responsabilités

• Assurer le montage, la mise en service, la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements électriques, d'instrumentation et d'automation.

• Diagnostiquer et résoudre les pannes afin de garantir la continuité de nos opérations.

• Participer à l'amélioration de la fiabilité des installations et proposer des solutions innovantes pour optimiser leur performance.

• Identifier les problématiques d'obsolescence et contribuer à la définition des standards techniques de demain.

• Garantir la conformité des interventions dans le respect des exigences GMP, des CAPA et des processus de Change Control.

• Réaliser les contrôles périodiques et les activités d'étalonnage des équipements d'instrumentation.

• Assurer la conformité des installations selon les normes ASE, OIBT et NIBT.

• Participer au service de piquet technique afin de garantir le support nécessaire à l'exploitation du site.

Votre profil

Vous êtes un professionnel de terrain qui aime comprendre les problèmes techniques, trouver des solutions durables et travailler au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.

Vous disposez idéalement des qualifications suivantes :

• CFC d'automaticien, de monteur-automaticien, d'installateur-électricien ou d'électronicien.

• Expérience confirmée en maintenance industrielle et en systèmes d'automation.

• Bonnes connaissances des automates Siemens S7 et des protocoles de communication industriels.

• Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques, pneumatiques et mécaniques.

• Connaissances des environnements GMP ou réglementés constituant un avantage.

• Certification OIBT art. 13 souhaitée.

• Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels et de SAP.

• Français courant ; l'anglais et/ou l'allemand sont des atouts.

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne organisée, autonome, dotée d'un fort esprit d'analyse et appréciant le travail en équipe.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un environnement de travail moderne et en pleine croissance.

• Des projets variés à forte valeur ajoutée.

• Une culture d'entreprise fondée sur la collaboration, l'amélioration continue et l'innovation.

• Des opportunités de développement professionnel et de formation continue.

• La possibilité de contribuer directement à la fabrication de produits ayant un impact positif sur la santé des patients.

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ?

Rejoignez une entreprise internationale en forte croissance où votre expertise technique contribuera chaque jour à la fiabilité et à la performance de nos installations.

Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature.

descriptionByLocale.en:
In order to strengthen our Maintenance & Engineering team on our Vionnaz website, we are looking for a Maintenance Automatician & Instrumentation (a) passionate about technique, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Your Impact As an expert in automation, instrumentation and electrical systems, you play a key role in the availability, safety and performance of our production equipment. You intervene directly on strategic facilities in a demanding and highly regulated environment. Your Responsibilities
• Ensure assembly, commissioning, preventive and corrective maintenance of electrical equipment, instrumentation and automation.
• Diagnosis and resolve breakdowns to ensure continuity of our operations.
• Participate in improving the reliability of installations and propose innovative solutions to optimize their performance.
• Identify the problems of obsolescence and contribute to the definition of the technical standards of tomorrow.
• Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, CAPA and Change Control processes.
• Perform periodic inspections and calibration activities of instrumentation.
• Ensure compliance with ASE, ITTO and NIBT standards.
• Participate in the technical picket service in order to guarantee the support necessary to operate the site. Your profile You are a field professional who likes to understand technical problems, find durable solutions and work in multidisciplinary teams. You ideally have the following qualifications:
• SWC of automatic, assembler-automatician or installer-electrician.
• Experience in industrial maintenance and automation systems.
• Good knowledge of Siemens S7 controllers and industrial communication protocols.
• Controlling the reading of electrical, pneumatic and mechanical diagrams.
• Knowledge of GMP or regulated environments providing an advantage.
• ITTO certification Art. 13 desired.
• Good control of common computer tools and SAP.
• Current French; English and/or German are assets. Beyond your technical skills, we look for an organized, self-sustaining person with a strong analytical spirit and enjoying teamwork. What we offer you
• A modern and growing working environment.
• Various projects with high added value.
• A corporate culture based on collaboration, continuous improvement and innovation.
• Opportunities for professional development and continuing training.
• The possibility of directly contributing to the production of products that have a positive impact on patient health. Ready to meet the challenge? Join a growing international company where your technical expertise will contribute every day to the reliability and performance of our facilities. We look forward to receiving your application.

To strengthen our active ingredient pilot department, we are looking for a motivated laboratory technician (f/m/d) 100%. In our production facility you produce pharmaceutically effective oligonucleotides and related substances. You work under GMP conditions and use modern production systems from production to purification. Through the practice-oriented training, you will gain the necessary confidence to work independently and responsibly on our production systems and become part of our team. If it is important to you to work with us beyond your daily work to continually improve our production facilities and work processes and you value the opportunity to help shape your working conditions in this way, then you have come to the right place.
• Your tasks: You control and monitor our manufacturing processes at the interface to R&D. You document in accordance with GMP and check the batch documentation. They help qualify the production equipment. You prepare in-process controls and samples and sometimes carry them out yourself. Together with the responsible group leaders, you make decisions for the further course of production, for example based on in-process controls. You carry out cleaning and maintenance work as well as simple repair work on the production systems. They are preparing manufacturing campaigns. To do this, you provide equipment, solvents and raw materials in the respective production rooms and check the equipment and systems. You will work actively and independently on the constant improvement of our production facilities and work processes.
• Your profile: Completed training as a chemical laboratory technician, chemical technician or equivalent training or chemical and pharmaceutical technologist. Flexibility, communication and willingness to learn are among your strengths. Preference for working and documenting according to GMP specifications as well as experience in a GMP environment is an advantage. You are characterized by a high level of reliability, independence and ability to work in a team. You are interested in technical connections and automated processes. A structured and saucy one

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global Engineering department, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q) Lead (f/m/d), 100%.

In this role, you are responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and oversight of commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for GMP ‑ regulated pharmaceutical facilities. Furthermore, this role ensures that all systems, equipment, and utilities are delivered in full compliance with regulatory requirements, quality standards, and project timelines. Acting as a technical and regulatory leader, the position interfaces closely with Engineering, Quality, Automation, Operations, and external partners throughout the project lifecycle.

Your tasks:

• Lead and manage commissioning, qualification, and validation activities for pharmaceutical facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems

• Develop and implement C&Q strategies, C&Q Master Plans, and risk ‑ based qualification approaches

• Author, review, and approve GMP documentation including URS, risk assessments, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols and reports

• Ensure compliance with GMP regulations and internal quality standards

• Act as the primary C&Q interface to Quality Assurance and support regulatory inspections and audits

• Coordinate cross ‑ functional stakeholders and manage external vendors and CQV consultants

• Monitor progress, manage risks, deviations, and change controls, and provide transparent reporting to project leadership

• Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and best practices across C&Q activities

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related technical discipline

• Extensive experience in Commissioning & Qualification / Validation within the pharmaceutical industry

• Proven track record of leading C&Q activities on large scale GMP capital projects

• Strong knowledge of GMP regulations (EU/FDA), ISPE guidelines, and risk based qualification methodologies

• Experience with facilities and utilities (e.g. HVAC, media systems); automation and CSV experience is an advantage

• Excellent written and spoken German and English

jobs.description:
Bachem is a leading, innovation-driven company specializing in the development and manufacture of peptides and oligonucleotides. With over 50 years of experience and expertise Bachem provides products for research, clinical development and commercial application to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies worldwide and offers a comprehensive range of services. Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

As  Automation Engineer  /  Project Engineer  for the  Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) , you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

Your Tasks:

• Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups

• Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments

• Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios

• Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components

• Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments

• Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab

• Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting

• Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation

• Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable

• Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

Your Profile:

• University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

• Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups

• Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

• Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

Bachem operates internationally with headquarters in Switzerland and locations in Europe, the US and Asia. The company is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange. For further information, see www.bachem.com.

As Automation Engineer / Project Engineer for the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab 100% (m/w/d) , you will play a central role in building, operating, and advancing our laboratory environment for digital manufacturing solutions. You will combine expertise in process automation, simulation, and lab infrastructure to enable engineers, data scientists, and developers to design, test, and deploy innovative solutions.

With a strong focus on PCS7-based automation systems, SIMIT simulations, and lab infrastructure, you will act as a technical allrounder bridging automation, IT/OT development systems, and user enablement. Your work will directly support experimentation, prototyping, and scaling of digital and automation solutions across TechOps and manufacturing.

Your Tasks:

• Design, implement, and maintain the Digital Manufacturing & Data Lab infrastructure, including automation systems, virtualized environments, and network setups

• Develop, configure, and support Siemens PCS7 systems (incl. WinCC, Simatic Batch) for lab and pilot environments

• Build and maintain simulation capabilities and digital twins using SIMIT, enabling virtual commissioning, testing, and training scenarios

• Administer and operate lab IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, systems, and network components

• Integrate controllers, field devices, and lab equipment into cohesive automation and data environments

• Provide and maintain internal tools, templates, and automation libraries for users of the lab

• Support users (engineers, data scientists) in utilizing lab systems for experiments, testing, and troubleshooting

• Participate in automation and digitalization projects, from requirements gathering to prototyping and implementation

• Maintain system documentation, ensure configuration management, and support testing activities where applicable

• Identify opportunities to improve the lab environment and introduce new technologies and best practices

Your Profile:

• University degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field

• Hands-on experience with process control systems, ideally Siemens PCS7, WinCC, and Simatic Batch, as well as simulation tools such as SIMIT or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of automation hardware, PLCs, controllers, field instrumentation, system integration, and industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus)

• Practical knowledge of IT/OT infrastructure, including virtualization, Windows administration, TCP/IP networking, virtual environments (e.g., VMware, Proxmox), and network segmentation in lab setups

• Exposure to data systems (e.g., historians, MES, analytics platforms), their integration with automation systems, and experience in virtual commissioning and digital twin approaches

• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work across disciplines, act as a technical allrounder, and translate user needs into practical technical solutions

• Dedicated, self-driven, structured, and collaborative personality with a hands-on mindset; solid knowledge of German is considered a strong plus

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Global Engineering suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Project Director Grossprojekte (a), 100%.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Gesamtverantwortung für komplexe Gross- und Investitionsprojekte (Capex) über alle Projektphasen hinweg – von der Machbarkeitsstudie bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.

• Leitung und Steuerung von Machbarkeits-, Varianten- und Konzeptstudien inklusive technischer, wirtschaftlicher und regulatorischer Bewertung sowie Entscheidungsaufbereitung für Management-Gremien.

• Auswahl und Steuerung geeigneter Projektabwicklungsmodelle (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) aus Bauherren-/Owner-Sicht.

• Sicherstellung der Produktionsbereitschaft sowie der GMP-, Sicherheits- und Gesetzeskonformität von Anlagen, Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen.

• Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung von Neu- und Umbauten inklusive Integration von Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Führung interdisziplinärer Projektteams sowie Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister.

• Planung, Überwachung und Durchführung von Inbetriebnahme und Qualifizierung neuer Anlagen und Gebäude.

• Budgetverantwortung inkl. Planung, Konsolidierung und Überwachung von Investitions- und Betriebskosten.

Ihr Profil:

• Abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium (ETH/FH/TU) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Gross- und Investitionsprojekte im industriellen Umfeld, idealerweise GMP-reguliert.

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit Projektabwicklungsmodellen wie EPCm, EPC und AE&CM.

• Erfahrung in frühen Projektphasen (Machbarkeits- und Konzeptstudien) sowie in Governance- und Entscheidungsprozessen.

• Gutes technisches Gesamtverständnis für Prozess-, Automatisierungs- und Gebäudethemen.

• Erfahrung im Budget- und Investitionsmanagement (Capex/Opex).

• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit.

• Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT Department, we are looking for a dedicated SAP Solution Architect (a), 80% - 100%

As part of our SAP Competence Center the SAP Solution Architect is responsible for designing and governing scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP S/4HANA solutions across pharmaceutical manufacturing and logistics. The role focuses primarily on core business processes in Production, Maintenance, and Quality, ensuring a seamless integration with the Master Data Management System (MDM), Manufacturing Execution System (MES), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and other SAP and non-SAP applications. The architect drives modernization through SAP BTP, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation – supporting digital transformation, operational excellence and regulatory compliance across global supply chains.

Your tasks:

• Define and maintain the end-to-end solution architecture, ensuring scalability, security and alignment with enterprise standards

• Design modular, extensible solutions leveraging SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP and modern technologies (e.g. Fiori UX, cloud integration, AI / ML, IoT)

• Lead architecture for manufacturing and logistics processes, ensuring seamless integration across SAP Modules (PP, MM, WM) and compliance with GMP

• Optimize workflows for batch management, serialization, production execution and quality control while maintaining a Clean Core approach.

• Ensure robust integration and interoperability with LIMS, MES and other core systems

• Design compliant solutions adhering to GxP, CFR Part 11, Annex 11, ISO 27001 and support validation, audit readiness and architecture practices

• Drive governance and oversight across program and project lifecycles, securing architectural quality and harmonization across global sites

• Translate business requirements into scalable digital capabilities; facilitate workshops, roadmaps, and cross-functional alignment with senior stakeholders

• Provide thought leadership on modernization, emerging technologies and life science best practices

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering or a related field

• 5+ years of experience as an SAP Solution Architect in a regulated manufacturing or life science environment

• Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP)

• Strong background in designing, implementing and maintaining SAP core manufacturing and logistics modules

• Proven experience in ISA-95 integration frameworks, particularly across MES (Level 3) and ERP (Level 4 / 5) systems

• Strong architectural mindset with deep understanding of end-to-end manufacturing, quality and supply chain processes

As part of our SAP Competence Center the SAP Solution Architect is responsible for designing and governing scalable, integrated, and future-ready SAP S/4HANA solutions across pharmaceutical manufacturing and logistics. The role focuses primarily on core business processes in Production, Maintenance, and Quality, ensuring a seamless integration with the Master Data Management System (MDM), Manufacturing Execution System (MES), Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) and other SAP and non-SAP applications. The architect drives modernization through SAP BTP, cloud technologies, and intelligent automation – supporting digital transformation, operational excellence and regulatory compliance across global supply chains.

• Lead architecture for manufacturing and logistics processes, ensuring seamless integration across SAP Modules (PP, MM, WM) and compliance with GMP

• Optimize workflows for batch management, serialization, production execution and quality control while maintaining a Clean Core approach.

• Ensure robust integration and interoperability with LIMS, MES and other core systems

• Drive governance and oversight across program and project lifecycles, securing architectural quality and harmonization across global sites

• Translate business requirements into scalable digital capabilities; facilitate workshops, roadmaps, and cross-functional alignment with senior stakeholders

• Provide thought leadership on modernization, emerging technologies and life science best practices

• Proven experience in ISA-95 integration frameworks, particularly across MES (Level 3) and ERP (Level 4 / 5) systems

• Strong architectural mindset with deep understanding of end-to-end manufacturing, quality and supply chain processes

Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Abteilung Production Support suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n Teamleader SPARK (a), 100%. (SPARK = SAP | Business Process Design | Operational Excellence | Administration | KPI & Reporting)

Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung eines Teams im Bereich Manufacturing Support

• Sicherstellung effizienter und standardisierter administrativer Prozesse innerhalb des Manufacturing

• Verantwortung für die Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP-Prozessen und Stammdaten

• Analyse, Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen im Produktionsumfeld

• Leitung und Umsetzung von Operational-Excellence- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen

• Weiterentwicklung von KPI-, Reporting- und Dashboard-Lösungen zur Unterstützung datenbasierter Entscheidungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, IT, Data Analytics und weiteren relevanten Schnittstellen
Unterstützung bei der Automatisierung und Digitalisierung bestehender Prozesse

• Sicherstellung einer hohen Datenqualität sowie transparenter Reporting-Strukturen

• Mitarbeit und Leitung bereichsübergreifender Projekte zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Qualität und Produktivität

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften, Digital Process Management oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Prozessmanagement, Operational Excellence, SAP oder Digitalisierung

• Erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung in einer Linien- oder Matrixorganisation

• Erfahrung im Produktionsumfeld, idealerweise in der Pharma-, Chemie- oder Life-Science-Industrie

• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse sowie datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung

• Erfahrung mit SAP sowie Reporting- und BI-Lösungen von Vorteil

• Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot:

• Ein dynamisches und stark wachsendes Arbeitsumfeld mit internen Weiterentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unserer Wirkstoff-Produktionsabteilung suchen wir eine/n motivierte/n Chemie- und Pharmatechnologen/Chemikanten (w/m/d).

In unserem Produktionsbetrieb stellen Sie pharmazeutisch wirksame Oligonukleotide und verwandte Substanzen her. Dabei arbeiten Sie unter GMP-Bedingungen und setzen von der Herstellung bis zur Aufreinigung moderne Produktionsanlagen ein. Über die praxisorientierte Einarbeitung werden Sie die notwendige Sicherheit gewinnen, selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich an unseren Produktionsanlagen zu arbeiten und ein Teil unseres Teams werden. Wenn es Ihnen darüber hinaus wichtig ist, über die tägliche Arbeit hinaus mit uns an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe zu arbeiten und die Möglichkeit schätzen, auf diese Weise Ihre Arbeitsbedingungen mitzugestalten, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Sie steuern, überwachen und beobachten unsere Herstellungsprozesse und dokumentieren GMP-gerecht.

• Sie kontrollieren die Chargen-Dokumentation.

• Sie helfen bei der Qualifizierung des Produktionsequipments.

• Sie bereiten In-Prozess-Kontrollen und Musterzüge vor und führen diese selbst durch.

• Sie treffen zusammen mit den verantwortlichen Gruppenleitern z.B. anhand von In-Prozess-Kontrollen Entscheide für den weiteren Produktionsverlauf.

• Sie führen Reinigungs- und Wartungsarbeiten sowie einfache Instandsetzungstätigkeiten an den Produktionsanlagen aus.

• Sie bereiten Herstellungskampagnen vor. Dafür stellen Sie Ausrüstung, Lösungsmittel und Ausgangsstoffe in den jeweiligen Produktionsräumen bereit und kontrollieren die Apparate und Anlagen.

• Sie arbeiten aktiv und selbstständig an der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produktionsanlagen und Arbeitsabläufe mit.

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group plans a new site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland as part of its long-term strategy to significantly expand production capacity. The new site will play a central role in supporting Bachem’s growth ambitions in peptide manufacturing.

To strengthen our Global Engineering organization, we are looking for a Senior Project Manager who will take full accountability for the successful delivery of large and complex CAPEX projects and build high-performing project teams from early concept through to operational readiness.

• Overall project responsibility
Take full accountability for large-scale CAPEX projects (>100 MCHF) across all project phases – from feasibility and concept studies through execution, commissioning, qualification and handover to operations

• Building and leading high-performing teams
Establish, onboard and lead multidisciplinary project teams; define clear roles, responsibilities and ways of working, and ensure effective collaboration across all project participants

• Owner’s project leadership and governance
Act as the Owner’s representative ensuring that project design and execution meets defined objectives (scope, functionality, capacity, cost, schedule, quality, safety and sustainability)
Drive governance processes including project charters, business cases, URS/URB inputs, and structured decision-making in alignment with Steering Committees

• Stakeholder alignment and integration
Align and integrate all key stakeholders (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) into one high-performing project team and ensure transparent communication and collaboration

• Execution strategy and partner management
Define and manage appropriate project delivery models (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) from an Owner’s perspective and lead external engineering partners, contractors and suppliers

• Project controls and performance management
Implement and ensure robust project controls (scope, schedule, cost, risk, change management) including structured reporting and forecasting (PMR) to senior management

• Compliance and regulatory excellence
Ensure compliance with GMP requirements, corporate standards, local regulations and building codes across all project phases

• Commissioning and operational readiness
Lead commissioning, qualification and start-up activities and ensure a smooth transition to operations including post-handover support (“hypercare”) to achieve stable and reliable performance

• Leadership in decision-making and problem solving
Identify, challenge and evaluate alternatives, drive decision-making and proactively resolve critical project issues in close alignment with the Steering Committee

Your Profile

• University degree (MSc / BSc) in Engineering, Construction or related discipline

• Minimum 10 years of experience in managing large capital projects in an industrial, preferably GMP-regulated environment

• Proven track record in leading complex CAPEX

Per rafforzare la nostra organizzazione di Ingegneria Globale, stiamo cercando un Senior Project Manager che terrà piena responsabilità per la consegna di progetti CAPEX di grandi e complessi e costruire team di progetto di alta qualità dal concetto iniziale fino alla disponibilità operativa.

• Costruire e dirigere squadre ad alto rendimento Stabilire, a bordo e condurre team di progetto multidisciplinari; definire ruoli chiari, responsabilità e modalità di lavoro e garantire una collaborazione efficace tra tutti i partecipanti al progetto
• Leader del progetto e governance del proprietario Agire come rappresentante del Titolare assicurando che la progettazione e l’esecuzione del progetto soddisfino obiettivi definiti (scopio, funzionalità, capacità, costo, programma, qualità, sicurezza e sostenibilità) Processi di governance di unità, tra cui charter di progetti, casi aziendali, ingressi URS/URB e processi decisionali strutturati in allineamento con i comitati direttivi
• Allineamento e integrazione degli Stakeholder Allineare e integrare tutti gli stakeholder chiave (User, QA, SHE, Manufacturing IT, Finance) in un unico team di progetto altamente performante e garantire una comunicazione trasparente e collaborazione
• Strategia di esecuzione e gestione dei partner Definire e gestire i modelli di consegna del progetto appropriati (EPCm, EPC, AE&CM) da una prospettiva del proprietario e guidare partner di ingegneria esterna, appaltatori e fornitori
• Controllo del progetto e gestione delle prestazioni Implementare e garantire robusti controlli di progetto (scopio, programma, costo, rischio, gestione dei cambiamenti) tra cui reportistica strutturata e previsione (PMR) alla gestione senior
• Compliance e eccellenza normativa Assicurare la conformità ai requisiti GMP, agli standard aziendali, alle normative locali e ai codici di costruzione in tutte le fasi del progetto
• Pronta Commissione e funzionamento Condurre attività di messa in servizio, qualificazione e start-up e garantire una transizione regolare alle operazioni, incluso il supporto post-handover (“hypercare”) per ottenere prestazioni stabili e affidabili
• Leadership nel processo decisionale e nella risoluzione dei problemi Identificare, sfidare e valutare alternative, guidare il processo decisionale e risolvere proattivamente i problemi critici del progetto in stretta allineamento con il Comitato direttivo Il tuo profilo
• Laurea in ingegneria, costruzione o disciplina relativa
• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione di grandi progetti di capitale in un ambiente industriale, preferibilmente regolamentato da GMP
• Prove tracce record nel complesso leader CAPEX

• Chromatography

• Filtration (UF/DF, TFF)

• Purification processes

• Degree in automation, chemical engineering, biotechnology or a related field

• At least 8–10 years of experience in automation within pharmaceutical or biotech environments

• Strong expertise in:

• Downstream process automation (chromatography, filtration, purification)

• DCS system (Siemens PCS7, PCSneo), PLC (e.g. Siemens TIA Portal), SCADA (WinCC) and batch control

• Experience with MES, historian and data/PAT integration

Per guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team in Global IT, stiamo cercando un SAP Solution & Implementation Lead (a), 80 – 100% , per progettare e implementare soluzioni SAP per la creazione del nostro nuovo sito di produzione GMP (Bachem Sisslerfeld). Il ruolo combina una profonda esperienza nei processi di produzione farmaceutica e supply chain con una forte attenzione alle capacità moderne, basate sui dati e all'innovazione digitale. Ciò include l'attivazione di processi integrati, intelligenti e altamente automatizzati basati su tecnologie digitali avanzate. Il candidato di successo contribuirà alla costruzione di soluzioni SAP scalabili, integrate e pronte al futuro per supportare la trasformazione digitale e l'eccellenza operativa. I vostri compiti: Progettare, implementare e migliorare continuamente le soluzioni SAP S/4HANA scalabili che supportano i processi di produzione e supply chain, assicurando la costruzione e la distribuzione di sistemi conformi e standardizzati in tutto il programma Abilitare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali end-to-end attraverso la produzione, la catena di fornitura e la qualità in ambienti regolati da GMP, applicando competenze di dominio della scienza della farm/vita Architetto e implementa l'integrazione tra i sistemi su piattaforme SAP e adiacenti (MES, LIMS, automazione del laboratorio), garantendo un flusso di dati senza soluzione di continuità e una coerenza di processo in tutto il paesaggio Guidare l'innovazione digitale offrendo processi altamente automatizzati e basati sui dati e supportando l'adozione di tecnologie SAP moderne come SAP Build e SAP AI Services Stabilire e mantenere la piena conformità normativa (GxP, CFR Parte 11, Allegato 11, ISO 27001), supportando la validazione del sistema informatico (CSV), le valutazioni dei rischi e la disponibilità di audit Coinvolgere gli stakeholder senior attraverso la produzione, la qualità, la supply chain e l'IT; tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni architettoniche e fornire governance attraverso programmi e cicli di vita di progetto Il tuo profilo: Bachelor o Master in IT, Ingegneria o campo relativo Un minimo di sette anni nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni SAP Competenza nell'integrazione ISA-95 (livello MES 3 / livello ERP 4–5) Esperienza SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP Conoscenza di GxP, CFR Parte 11, Allegato 11, ISO 27001 I sistemi MES e OT/automazione sperimentano un forte plus Fluency in tedesco e inglese richiesto L'esperienza nelle industrie regolamentate è un plus La nostra offerta

traduire les besoins des entreprises en solutions architecturales et assurer la gouvernance au cours des cycles de vie des programmes et des projets • Votre profil: Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie ou domaine connexe Un minimum de sept ans dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions SAP Expertise en intégration ISA-95 (MES niveau 3 / ERP niveau 4–5) Expérience pratique SAP S/4HANA et SAP BTP Connaissance de GxP, CFR Partie 11, Annexe 11, ISO 27001 Les systèmes MES et OT/automation connaissent un fort plus Connaissances en allemand et en anglais requises L'expérience dans les industries réglementées est un plus Notre offre

jobs.title: IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80-100%

titleByLocale.fr: IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Ingénieur (a), 80-100%

jobs.description:
The Bachem Group is investing in a new planned site in Sisslerfeld in Northwestern Switzerland. This step is part of the long-term strategy to expand production capacity by the end of the decade. The new production site will play a central role in achieving these goals. The design phase of the project offers you unique opportunities to shape the future organization.

To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer (a), 80 – 100%.

The IT/OT Network & Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, governing, and operationalizing enterprise and industrial network infrastructure across IT and OT environments while directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (i.e. digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts), with a strong focus on project delivery (new planned Sisslerfeld site) and long-term operational ownership.

The role acts as the key interface between Global IT, site teams, and project stakeholders, ensuring that all network and hosting components are aligned with corporate standards, security policies, and GxP regulations, while guaranteeing infrastructure readiness for project execution and sustainable operations.

In addition to architecture and delivery responsibilities, the role transitions into the on-site owner for IT run services, ensuring stable operations, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement after project completion.

Your tasks:

• Define, design, and govern network architectures within the BSF site project, aligned with global IT/OT network architectures across enterprise and industrial environments.

• Design and implement segmented IT/OT architectures (zones, DMZs, VLANs, secure data flows) and support industrial environments including SCADA, PLC, DCS, MES, and shop-floor systems.

• Act as primary infrastructure lead during project BSF, coordinating network and hosting activities between site management, project teams and Global IT while ensuring infrastructure readiness (network, connectivity, hosting, security) to support all project milestones and commissioning activities.

• Drive alignment between project design and corporate standards, including architecture reviews and approvals. Support site deployment activities including assessments, design validation, cutovers, testing, and go-live.

• Coordinate integration of network and hosting platforms (on-prem, hybrid, cloud) into end-to-end infrastructure solutions & ensure systems are designed for high availability, security, scalability, and operational sustainability.

• Govern and coordinate external service providers, system integrators, and network vendors. Review designs, proposals, and delivery quality of suppliers.

• Ensure compliance with GxP, data integrity, and cybersecurity standards (e.g., IEC 62443, ISO 27001) and support audits, risk assessments, and regulatory inspections.

• Maintain architecture documentation, standards, and validation-relevant deliverables.

• Transition into on-site owner for IT run services after project go-live by defining and establishing support models, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths, and service KPIs.

• Drive network standardization, modernization, and lifecycle management.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture and infrastructure design in enterprise and industrial GxP environments with strong hands-on expertise in LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, routing, switching, firewalls, and network security.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal Transformation globale du SGQ (a) - 100 %

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly capable Senior Manager – Global QMS Transformation to play a key role in delivering a global quality transformation program, including the implementation of a Veeva Vault-based enterprise quality platform.

In this role, you will act as the day-to-day execution lead and trusted partner to the Director, Global QMS Transformation, owning the execution of the implementation and ensuring it delivers measurable business value.

Your tasks

Drive Global Transformation

• Manage day-to-day execution of a global QMS implementation program

• Translate strategic objectives into structured, actionable plans

• Ensure delivery across all phases, including design, build, testing, and deployment

• Monitor progress, oversee risks, resolve issues, and maintain overall program momentum

• Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to define and implement harmonized QMS processes

• Balance business requirements with scalable and sustainable system solutions

• Drive alignment across functions and sites while navigating complexity

Manage Partners and Delivery

• Coordinate and oversee external vendors and system integrators

• Ensure high standards of delivery quality, accountability, and collaboration

• Maintain a pragmatic, results-oriented approach to execution

Ensure Compliance Integration and Business Readiness

• Embed compliance requirements into program execution in partnership with internal stakeholders

• Drive business readiness and successful deployment by leading and coordinating change management, communication, and training activities

Your Profile

• 8–10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology industries

• Proven experience supporting or leading system implementations and/or transformation programs, ideally in a global environment

• Solid understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and GMP frameworks

• Experience working across cross-functional stakeholders

• Experience implementing Veeva Vault (or other digital quality systems)

• Strong execution focus with a demonstrated ability to deliver results

• Ability to manage complexity and prioritize effectively in a dynamic environment

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

• Certification such as PMP (Project Management Professional) a

jobs.description:
To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated DevOps Platform Engineer, 100%.

We are building an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that lets teams across Bachem deliver applications in a standardized, self-service way. In this hands-on role you will build, operate and scale the platform – bringing your experience to strengthen its core foundations today, and helping grow it into the backbone that serves the whole organization tomorrow.

Your tasks:

• Build, automate and operate our Internal Developer Platform based on GitHub Enterprise and cloud infrastructure

• Design and maintain infrastructure as code to provision environments, resources and guardrails in a repeatable, auditable way

• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and reusable workflow templates in GitHub Actions, with quality, security and compliance built in

• Help scale the platform as adoption grows - improving reusable templates, guardrails and self-service capabilities so it serves more teams without more manual effort

• Keep the platform reliable, compliant and secure – monitoring, observability, incident response, patching and continuous improvement of operational practices

• Implement platform governance and guardrails: access management, policies, secrets handling and cost awareness

• Facilitate discussions and drive alignment across stakeholder groups with different priorities, translating their requirements into coherent, shared platform capabilities.

• Partner with developers across a wide range of skill levels: coaching newcomers, enabling professional developers and adapting your communication and support to each audience.

• Create documentation, guidelines and onboarding materials that make the platform easy to adopt for developers of every maturity level

• Collaborate closely with the Platform Owner to translate the platform roadmap into technical solutions

• Ensure platform reliability and security through monitoring, observability, and policy-driven governance

Your profile

• Degree in IT or equivalent practical experience in a field related to DevOps or software engineering

• 3-5 years of experience with DevOps or a closely related software engineering role

• Strong hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise, including GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines and repository governance

• Solid experience automating infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform) via GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, targeting Azure and/or AWS

• A product-oriented mindset and the drive to make developers more productive

• A collaborative, service‑oriented mindset that thrives in agile, iterative environments, measuring success by how productive and self‑sufficient you help platform users become

• Comfortable in an agile environment, delivering iteratively and self-organizing to keep steady progress

• Nice to have: Experience with regulated / GxP environments

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare center on the Bachem Campus in Bubendorf

I vostri compiti:

• Gestire e mantenere le operazioni cloud in linea con la sicurezza, la conformità e le politiche aziendali

• Progettazione, costruzione e supporto CI/CD con strumenti come GitHub Actions, AWS Code Pipeline e Jenkins

• Sviluppare e mantenere le soluzioni Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) utilizzando Terraform e AWS CloudFormation

• Rafforzare gli standard di ingegneria del cloud attraverso la governance, le recensioni dei pari e le migliori pratiche

• Soluzioni di monitoraggio, allerta e osservabilità per garantire affidabilità e prestazioni del sistema

• Automatizzare i processi operativi, inclusi patching, convalida di backup e controlli di conformità

• Collabora con i proprietari di applicazioni, team IT e l'organizzazione CISO per soddisfare i requisiti aziendali e normativi

• Supporta i processi di gestione dei cambiamenti, tra cui la partecipazione del CAB e la documentazione tecnica

• Fornire leadership tecnica, mentoring e contribuire a standard di governance cloud, politiche e runbook operativi

Il tuo profilo:

• Corso di laurea in informatica, IT, Ingegneria, o equivalente esperienza pratica

• 3+ anni di esperienza ingegneristica cloud AWS in un ambiente di produzione

• Esperienza di lavoro nelle industrie regolamentate (ad esempio, farmaceutica, biotecnologia, dispositivi medici)

• Forti competenze in Infrastructure-as-Code (preferibilmente Terraform) e scripting (Python, Bash, o PowerShell)

• Conoscenza solida dei servizi di sicurezza AWS e dei framework di conformità (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF)

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect (associate o superiori) o competenza equivalente

• Esperienza con DevOps e tecnologie cloud-native, tra cui Docker, Kubernetes/EKS e pratiche CI/CD

• Conoscenza del recupero dei disastri, della continuità aziendale e degli ambienti ibridi/multicloud

• Ulteriori vantaggi: AWS DevOps / Certificazioni di sicurezza, AWS Bedrock, Veeva Vault o sistemi convalidati, NIS2 competenze di conoscenza

• Fluente in inglese, tedesco è un plus

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo e formazione interne

• Ore lavorative flessibili con i giorni di ufficio e l'opzione per ottenere ulteriori giorni di vacanza attraverso la riduzione del carico di lavoro

• Centro di assistenza aziendale
descriptionByLocale.en:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Cloud Engineer (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Manage and maintain cloud operations in alignment with security, compliance, and company policies

• Design, build, and support CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, AWS Code Pipeline, and Jenkins

• Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation

• Enforce cloud engineering standards through governance, peer reviews, and best practices

• Implement monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to ensure system reliability and performance

• Automate operational processes, including patching, backup validation, and compliance checks

• Collaborate with application owners, IT teams, and the CISO organization to meet business and regulatory requirements

• Support change management processes, including CAB participation and technical documentation

• Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and contribute to cloud governance standards, policies, and operational runbooks

Your profile:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• 3+ years of hands-on AWS cloud engineering experience in a production environment

• Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., pharmaceutical, biotech, medical devices)

• Strong skills in Infrastructure-as-Code (preferably Terraform) and scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell)

• Solid knowledge of AWS security services and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF)

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or higher) or equivalent expertise

• Experience with DevOps and cloud-native technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and CI/CD practices

• Knowledge of disaster recovery, business continuity, and hybrid/multi-cloud environments

• Additional advantages: AWS DevOps/Security certifications, AWS Bedrock, Veeva Vault or validated systems, NIS2 knowledge skills

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

• Flexible working hours with home office days and an option for obtaining additional vacation days through workload reduction

• Company‑run daycare cente

jobs.title: IT Enterprise Architect, Manufacturing & Operations (a), 80-100%

titleByLocale.fr: IT Enterprise Architecte, Manufacturing & Operations (a), 80-100%

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in Global IT, we are looking for a dedicated IT Enterprise Architect (a), 80-100%

Your tasks:

• Define and drive the Manufacturing Enterprise Architecture roadmap aligned with business strategy and GxP/regulatory requirements.

• Establish and govern architecture principles, standards, and technology roadmaps across global manufacturing programs

• Lead the technology architecture for new manufacturing facilities and the modernization of existing sites

• Design and oversee the integration architecture between OT, manufacturing systems, and enterprise platforms

• Ensure compliance with GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and other applicable pharmaceutical regulations

• Shape enterprise integration, API, middleware, and data platform strategies, including MDM and advanced analytics capabilities

• Enable real-time data exchange between manufacturing operations and business systems through Industry 4.0 technologies

• Drive digital manufacturing initiatives, including MES, digital twins, predictive maintenance, batch analytics, and eBR solutions

• Partner with senior business, engineering, quality, and regulatory stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business objectives

• Mentor architects, support strategic technology selections, and lead architectural governance, vendor evaluations, and due diligence activities

Your profile:

• 10+ years of progressive IT architecture experience, including 5+ years in a Senior/Principal Enterprise Architect role

• Proven experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry with strong knowledge of GxP, CSV/CSA, and regulatory requirements

• Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing environments, including greenfield and/or major brownfield facility projects

• Strong enterprise application architecture expertise, ideally with SAP S/4HANA

• Proven track record in designing and governing large-scale enterprise integration architectures and API ecosystems

• Experience defining and implementing enterprise data strategies, including data platforms, MDM, analytics, and data lake architecture

• Solid knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF); certification is an advantage

• Hands-on experience with digital manufacturing technologies such as MES, SCADA, DCS, eBR, LIMS, or related platforms

• Good understanding of Industry 4.0, OT/IT convergence, industrial cybersecurity, IoT, and advanced manufacturing concepts

Our offer:

• A dynamic and rapidly growing work environment with internal development and training opportunities

jobs.description:
Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in der Forschung & Entwicklung suchen wir eine/n engagierte/n  Scientist Peptidwirkstoffe R&D LPPS/TAPS (w/m/d), 100%. Das Arbeitsgebiet umfasst zahlreiche unterschiedliche Schritte der modernen Synthese von peptidischen Wirkstoffen, Peptidfragmenten und Aminosäurebausteinen in Lösung, sowie diverse Technologien zur Aufkonzentration und Isolation der Produkte.

Ihre Aufgaben:

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Analyse und Interpretation von Experimenten sowie die Darstellung der erhaltenen Ergebnisse

• Planung und zeitgerechte Durchführung von Entwicklungsarbeiten bzw. Prozessoptimierungen in Kooperation mit anderen Abteilungen unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Sicherheit

• Durchführung von Prozesstransfers (Scale-up) und Unterstützung der Produktion bei Einführung neuer Prozesse, z.T. unter cGMP-Richtlinien

• Fokus auf den LPPS/TAPS-Bereich (Organische Chemie in Lösung, Peptidkupplungen, Schutzgruppenchemie, Extraktion, Fällung, Kristalisation)

• Verfassen von Berichten und Erstellen von Präsentationen zu den durchgeführten Arbeiten für interne und externe Kunden

• Unterstützung der Produktion beim Lösen von chemischen Herausforderungen (Troubleshooting)

• Aktive Beteiligung an der ständigen Verbesserung unseres Equipments und der Arbeitsabläufe sowie Unterhalt der Laborinfrastruktur

Ihr Profil:

• Promotion in Chemie

• Erfahrungen in der präparativen organischen Synthese und ein Faible für Prozesstechnik

• Eine strukturierte, genaue und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, die es Ihnen erlaubt, jederzeit den Überblick zu behalten

• Ausgeprägte kommunikative und organisatorische Fähigkeiten

• Zuverlässigkeit, Selbstständigkeit und Teamfähigkeit

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Kenntnisse in Peptidchemie und gängigen Analysetechniken wie UHPLC und LC-MS sind von Vorteil

Unser Angebot:

• Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung mit Möglichkeit für Home-Office und Option zum Bezug zusätzlicher Ferientage mit reduziertem Arbeitspensum

• Mitarbeiterförderung durch zahlreiche interne und externe Weiterbildungsangebote

• 60%-ige Übernahme der Pensionskassenbeiträge durch Bachem AG sowie Möglichkeit für überobligatorische Vorsorge mit unserem Wahlsparplan

• Zugang zu Vorteilsplattform mit Rabatten bei externen Partnern

descriptionByLocale.it:
Al fine di guidare la nostra continua crescita organica, siamo costantemente alla ricerca di professionisti altamente qualificati. Per rafforzare il nostro team di ricerca e sviluppo, stiamo cercando un ingrediente attivo dedicato di peptide scienziato R&D LPPS/TAPS (m/f/d), 100%. Il campo di lavoro comprende numerosi passaggi diversi nella sintesi moderna di sostanze attive peptide, frammenti di peptide e blocchi di costruzione di aminoacidi in soluzione, così come varie tecnologie per la concentrazione e l'isolamento dei prodotti.

I loro compiti:

• Responsabilità per la pianificazione, l'analisi e l'interpretazione degli esperimenti nonché la presentazione dei risultati ottenuti

• Pianificazione e tempestiva esecuzione del lavoro di sviluppo o ottimizzazione dei processi in collaborazione con altri dipartimenti tenendo conto della qualità, dell'efficienza e della sicurezza

• Attuazione dei trasferimenti di processo (scala) e sostegno alla produzione all'introduzione di nuovi processi, in parte secondo le linee guida del CGMP

• Focus sulla zona LPPS/TAPS (chimica organica in soluzione, accoppiamenti peptide, chimica del gruppo protettivo, estrazione, precipitazione, cristallizzazione)

• Scrivere report e presentazioni sul lavoro svolto per clienti interni ed esterni

• Sostenere la produzione nella risoluzione delle sfide chimiche (risoluzione dei problemi)

• Partecipazione attiva al miglioramento continuo delle nostre attrezzature e processi di lavoro nonché alla manutenzione dell'infrastruttura di laboratorio

Il tuo profilo:

• Dottorato in Chimica

• Esperienza nella sintesi organica preparatoria e debolezza della tecnologia di processo

• Un modo di lavoro strutturato, preciso e indipendente che consente di mantenere sempre una panoramica

• Forte comunicazione e capacità organizzative

• Affidabilità, indipendenza e lavoro di squadra

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• La conoscenza della chimica del peptide e le tecniche analitiche comuni come UHPLC e LC-MS sono vantaggiose

La nostra offerta:

• Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e in rapida crescita con opportunità di sviluppo interno

• Ore di lavoro flessibili con la possibilità di ufficio domestico e la possibilità di acquistare vacanze aggiuntive con carico di lavoro ridotto

• Supporto dei dipendenti attraverso numerose offerte di formazione interna ed esterna

• Il 60% dei contributi dei fondi pensione da parte di Bachem AG e la possibilità di un'offerta sovraobbligatoria con il nostro piano di risparmio elettivo

• Accesso alla piattaforma di vantaggio con sconti da partner esterni

• Cibo fresco, sano e vario nel nostro ristorante personale

• Varie attività sportive gratuite sul campus di Bachem

Vuoi guidare l'innovazione insieme a noi?

Abbiamo suscitato il vostro interesse? Quindi non vediamo l'ora che i tuoi documenti applicativi siano completi tramite il nostro portale.

Scopri di più sul Gruppo Bachem e ispirati al nostro ambiente di lavoro stimolante nella nostra posizione a Bubendorf!

A Bachem troverai una squadra multiculturale e diversificata. La (a) nel titolo del lavoro è per tutti. Accogliamo le domande di tutti i candidati. Ciò che conta sono le vostre abilità e motivazione, indipendentemente dall'età, dal sesso, dallo sfondo, dalla religione o dall'orientamento sessuale.

Le domaine de travail comprend de nombreuses étapes dans la synthèse moderne des substances actives peptidiques, des fragments de peptides et des blocs de construction d'acides aminés en solution, ainsi que diverses technologies pour la concentration et l'isolement des produits.

Leurs tâches:

• Responsabilité de la planification, de l'analyse et de l'interprétation des expériences ainsi que de la présentation des résultats obtenus

• Planification et exécution en temps voulu des travaux de développement ou d'optimisation des processus en coopération avec d'autres départements, en tenant compte de la qualité, de l'efficacité et de la sécurité

• Mise en œuvre des transferts de procédés (échelle) et soutien de la production lors de l'introduction de nouveaux procédés, en partie dans le cadre des lignes directrices sur les BPFc

• Focus sur la zone LPPS/TAPS (chimie organique en solution, couplages peptides, chimie de groupe protectrice, extraction, précipitation, cristallisation)

• Rédiger des rapports et des exposés sur le travail effectué pour les clients internes et externes

• Soutien à la production pour résoudre les problèmes chimiques (dépannage)

• Participation active à l'amélioration continue de nos équipements et de nos processus de travail ainsi qu'à l'entretien de l'infrastructure de laboratoire

Votre profil:

• Doctorat en chimie

• Expérience de la synthèse organique préparatoire et faiblesse de la technologie des procédés

• Une façon de travailler structurée, précise et indépendante qui vous permet de garder un aperçu en tout temps

• Fortes compétences en communication et en organisation

• Fiabilité, indépendance et travail d'équipe

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

• La connaissance de la chimie des peptides et des techniques d'analyse courantes telles que l'UHPLC et la LC-MS sont avantageuses

Notre offre:

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et en croissance rapide avec des possibilités de développement interne

• Heures de travail flexibles avec possibilité de bureau à domicile et possibilité d'acheter des vacances supplémentaires avec une charge de travail réduite

jobs.description: Um unser kontinuierliches organisches Wachstum voranzutreiben, suchen wir ständig nach hochqualifizierten Fachkräften. titleByLocale.fr: Architecte réseau mondial IT/OT (f/m/d), 100%

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. To strengthen our team in the Global IT department, we are looking for a dedicated Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100%.

The Global IT/OT Network Architect defines and governs the company’s global network architecture across enterprise IT and operational technology environments, directly supporting Bachem’s digital strategy (digital manufacturing, pharma 4.0 concepts).

The role combines full ownership and design authority of enterprise & industrial/OT network architecture, and site-level solution architecture for offices, production environments, warehouses, and laboratories, including a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap.

The role ensures that IT and OT networks are secure, resilient, scalable, standardized, maintainable, and aligned with business, operational, cybersecurity, and GxP compliance requirements.

Your tasks :

• Define and maintain global network architecture standards for enterprise, industrial, cloud, and site environments across global sites. Assume full ownership and design authority for global network architecture.

• Support Bachem’s digital strategy, in particular digital manufacturing and Pharma 4.0 concepts, and provide technical governance for managed service providers, telecom carriers, automation vendors, and OT system integrators.

• Own a multi-year IT/OT network strategy and roadmap, including modernization, standardization, technical debt reduction, and end-of-life planning.

• Design secure and resilient OT network architectures for shop-floor and production environments, including IT/OT segmentation using zones, conduits, DMZs, firewalls, VLANs, access controls, and controlled data flows.

• Ensure local network designs align with global standards and site-specific operational needs by supporting design reviews, commissioning, cutovers, migrations, acceptance testing, and post-implementation validation.

• Ensure network architecture supports cybersecurity, risk, and GxP compliance requirements across IT and OT by aligning with internal policies and relevant standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, NIST OT security guidance, and ITIL practices.

• Maintain architecture documentation, including standards, reference architectures, site blueprints, segmentation models, design templates, decision records, exceptions, and risk acceptance documentation.

• Ensure designs are operationally supportable by IT, OT, site, and managed service teams, and define operational runbooks, support models, escalation paths, and disaster recovery requirements.

Your profile:

• Extensive experience in network architecture, infrastructure architecture, or senior network engineering in global or multi-site enterprise environments, ensuring GxP compliance.

• Practical experience with OT or industrial networks designing IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity patterns in manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, or similar environments.

descriptionByLocale.it: Mansioni Global IT/OT Network Architect (f/m/d), 100% Descrizione Per supportare la nostra crescita organica continua, stiamo cercando professionisti altamente qualificati. Per aumentare la nostra squadra nel dipartimento IT globale, stiamo cercando un Global IT/OT Network Architect dedicato (f/m/d), 100%. Il Global IT/OT Network Architect definisce e governa l'architettura di rete globale dell'azienda in ambienti IT aziendali e tecnologie operative, supportando direttamente la strategia digitale di Bachem (manifattura digitale, concetti Pharma 4.0). Il ruolo combina la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione dell'architettura di rete aziendale e industriale/OT, nonché l'architettura delle soluzioni a livello di sito per uffici, ambienti di produzione, laboratori, inclusa una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine. Il ruolo garantito che le reti IT e OT siano sicure, resilienti, scalabili, standardizzate, manutenibili e allineate ai requisiti aziendali, operative, di sicurezza informatica e di conformità GxP. Compiti - Definire e mantenere gli standard di architettura di rete globale per gli ambienti aziendali, industriali, cloud e sito in tutto il mondo. Assumi la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione per l'architettura di rete globale. - Supportare la strategia digitale di Bachem, in particolare la manifattura digitale e i concetti Pharma 4.0, e fornire la governance tecnica per i fornitori di servizi organizzati, le compagnie telefoniche, i fornitori di automazione e gli integratori di sistemi OT. - Possedere una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine, inclusi la modernizzazione, la standardizzazione, la riduzione del debito tecnico e la pianificazione della fine del ciclo di vita. - Progettare architetture di rete OT sicuro e resilienti per gli ambienti di produzione a piano terra, inclusa la segmentazione IT/OT local Zone, condottier, DMZ, firewall, VLAN, controlli di accesso e flussi di dati controllati. - Garantire che i progetti di rete locali siano allineati con gli standard globali e le esigenze operative site-specific attraverso il supporto alle revisioni di progettazione, alla messa in servizio, ai passaggi, alle migrazioni, ai test di accettazione e alla validazione post-implementazione. - Garantire che l'architettura della rete supporti i requisiti di sicurezza informatica, il rischio e la conformità GxP in tutto l'IT e l'OT allineandosi con le politiche interna e gli standard definiti come IEC 62443, ISO 27001, le linee guida sulla sicurezza OT di NIST e le pratiche ITIL. - Mantenere la documentazione dell'architettura, inclusi gli standard, le architetture di riferimento, i piani delle site, i modelli di segmentazione, i template di progettazione, i registri delle decisioni, le teorie e la documentazione di accettazione del rischio. - Garantire che le progettazioni siano supportate operativemente dagli team IT, OT, site e dei servizi idonei, e definire i manuali operativi, i modelli di supporto, i percorsi di escalation e i requisiti di recupero di emergenza. Profilo - Esperienza estesa in architettura di rete, architettura dell'obiettivo o ingegneria di rete senior in ambienti aziendali globali o multi-sito, garantendo la conformità GxP. - Esperienza pratica con le reti OT o industriale progettando la segmentazione IT/OT e i modelli di connessione sicura nella manifattura, nella farmaceutica o in ambienti simili. Il Global IT/OT Network Architect definisce e gouverna l'architettura di rete globale dell'azienda in ambitori IT aziendali e tecnologie operating, supportando direttamente la strategia digitale di Bachem (manifattura digitale, concetti Pharma 4.0). Il ruolo combina la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione dell'architettura di rete aziendale e industriale/OT, nonché l'architettura delle soluzioni a livello di sito per uffici, ambienti di produzione, magazzini e laboratori, inclusa una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine. Il ruolo garantie che le reti IT e OT siano sicure, resilisi, scalabili, standardizzate, manutenibili e allineate ai requisiti aziendali, opérativi, di sicurezza informatica e di conformità GxP. Compiti - Définire e mantenere gli standard di architettura di rete globale per gli ambienti aziendali, industriali, cloud e sito in tutto il mondo. Assumi la piena proprietà e l'autorità di progettazione per l'architettura di rete globale. - Supportare la strategia digitale di Bachem, in particolare la manifattura digitale e i concetti Pharma 4.0, e fornire la gouvernance tecnica per i fornitori di servizi gestiti, le compagnie telefoniche, i fornitori di automazione e gli integratori di sistemi OT. - Possedere una strategia e un piano di rete IT/OT a lungo termine, inclusi la modernizzazione, la standardizzazione, la riduzione del debito tecnico e la pianificazione della fine del ciclo di vita. - Progettare architecture di rete OT sicure e resilisi per gli ambienti di produzione a piano terra, inclusa la segmentazione IT/OT usezando zone, condotti, DMZ, pare-feu, VLAN, controlli di accesso e flussi di dati controllati. - Garantire che i progetti di rete locali siano alleati con gli standard globali e le esigenze operational site-specific attraverso il supporto alle revisioni di progettazio, alla messa in servizio, ai passaggi, alle migrazioni, ai test di accettazione e alla validazione post-implementazione. - Garantie che l'architettura della rete supporti i requisiti di sicurezza informatica, il rischio e la conformità GxP in tutto l'IT e l'OT alleandosi con le politicienhe interne e gli standard rilevanti come IEC 62443, ISO 27001, le linee guida sulla sicurezza OT di NIST e le pratiche ITIL. - Mantenere la documentazione dell'architettura, inclusi gli standard, le architecture di riferimento, i piani delle site, i modelli di segmentazione, i template di progettazione, i registri delle decisioni, le eccezioni e la documentazione di accettazione del rischio. - Garantire che le progettazioni siano supportate opérativamente dagli team IT, OT, site e dei servizi gestiti, e definire i manuali opérativi, i modelli di supporto, i percorsi di escalade e i requisiti di recupero di emergenza. Profil - Esperienza estesa in architettura di rete, architettura dell'infrastruttura o ingegneria di rete senior in ambienti aziendali globali o multi-sito, garantendo la conformità GxP. - Esperienza pratica con le reti OT o industriali progettando la segmentazione IT/OT e i modelli di connessione sicura nella manifattura, nella farmaceutica o in ambienti simili. jobs.title: Patent Counsel (a), 80 - 100%

titleByLocale.fr: Conseiller en brevets (a), 80 - 100%

jobs.description:
To drive our continuous organic growth, we are constantly looking for highly qualified professionals. For our Group Intellectual Property team in Bubendorf/BL, we are seeking a highly skilled Patent Counsel (a), 80 – 100% . To support and protect our innovation-driven business, the Group Intellectual Property plays a pivotal role in securing competitive advantages, supporting technological progress, and creating long-term value across the organization.

In this highly visible role, you will work closely with scientists, R&D teams, and business stakeholders across the organization. Your responsibilities will span the full spectrum of intellectual property activities, including invention harvesting, patent drafting, and global patent prosecution. In addition, you will serve as a trusted advisor on IP-related matters, providing practical and business-oriented guidance to internal partners and helping to shape the company's innovation strategy in a dynamic and rapidly growing environment. Patent Counsel – Shape the Future of Innovation at Bachem

Your tasks:

• Collaborate with inventors, engineers, and scientists to identify potentially patentable inventions

• Conduct patentability searches

• Provide strategic advice on optimal protection routes

• Guide inventors in documenting inventions and preparing high-quality invention disclosures

• Draft, file, and prosecute patent applications to secure and maintain IP protection worldwide

• Manage and instruct external patent counsel as appropriate

• Instruct and supervise FTO searches

• Conduct freedom-to-operate (FTO) analyses and assess third-party rights.

• Advice on infringement risks and measures for risk mitigation.

• Draft contractual positions and advice on IP related matters

Your profile:

• Qualification as a European Patent Attorney

• A strong scientific background in chemistry or a closely related discipline

• Proven experience in patent prosecution

• Experience in reviewing, drafting, and negotiating IP-related agreements

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail

• Team player with the ability to perform effectively in a dynamic environment

• Excellent communication skills in English and German
